purpose: Next Share logo concepts for user selection

variants.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create one original, premium Windows desktop app icon for 'Next Share', an offline file sharing app. Clean Google Material 3 sensibility, warm and precise, bold silhouette readable at 24px, vector-like crisp edges, no text or letters other than a deliberately designed N if requested, no watermark, no mockup or screenshot. Square composition, a single large softly rounded square app tile centered, ample transparent margin outside the tile. Teal (#007D72), mint (#BFE9DF), and deep green (#103B36) brand palette. Avoid Bluetooth logos, Google Quick Share marks, Apple AirDrop marks, LocalSend logo, generic wifi symbol. Concept 01: N PORTAL. A strong geometric capital N formed from two rounded vertical pillars and one diagonal bridge, with a clean negative-space arrow passing through the bridge toward the upper right. White or pale mint monogram on rich teal tile. Flat, sophisticated, compact, memorable, no gradients.
